commons-steward-ordered-convergence.statement: Each Commons grant has one independent monotonic steward sequence; cursor-gapped members converge to the same domain state, and capability downgrades govern commands from their exact stream position onward.

placement-registry-parity.statement: Every placeable blueprint entity is enumerated once and Locker is structurally excluded.

custody-seat-exclusion.statement: Record-only blueprint apps never import or render byte-custody machinery.

consent-domain-parity.statement: Blueprint consent surfaces and automation scheduling recognize the same enrichment domains.

triage-session-progress.statement: Proposal queues share frozen progress, distinct skip semantics, and reachable completion.

search-scaffold-grouping.statement: Search entity configuration owns grouping, ordering, caps, and result-state truth.

per-scope-reach.statement: Every mounted scope reports whether search reached it, was offline, or refused the query instead of collapsing those states into no matches.

mask-refuses-not-no-matches.statement: A field-masked search refusal remains a typed refusal through the replica and search-scaffold boundary and is never rendered as an honest empty result.

recognition-self-contained.statement: Blueprint apps, automations, and mobile code use host-owned model seams and never resurrect provider SDKs or deleted inference roads.

one-computation.statement: A pure product-law computation is a projection or a shared module imported by every seat, never two seat-local implementations.

people-photograph-counts.statement: Every seat counts distinct confirmed photographs, not face regions or unconfirmed proposals, and keeps unnamed groups separate.

enrichment-model-lock.statement: Every live-model file and native runtime dependency is immutable by version/digest and its permissive licence is recorded in LICENSES.md.

enrichment-live.statement: Pinned real weights satisfy the advertised capability/model handshake and the committed OCR, embedding, and face-geometry goldens.

backup-round-trip.statement: A restored snapshot reproduces the vault byte-identically — same files, same directory tree, plus the quarantine marker.

backup-incremental.statement: A second snapshot after a small change uploads far fewer chunks than the first, so backup cost tracks change, not vault size.

backup-no-change.statement: A run over an unchanged vault registers nothing and returns null, so an idle machine never mints snapshots.

backup-restore-refusal.statement: Restore refuses a non-empty destination, a newer vaultUserVersion, an unknown format, and a manifest whose hash does not verify — and refuses before fetching or materializing anything.

backup-verify.statement: Verification detects a deleted chunk and a corrupted chunk, and reports a clean snapshot as clean.

flows.approvedMinimumTestsDeviation: #656 Layer 1D single-owner de-duplication: removed four example tests whose property twins in the same file already own the law — 'records ONE entry per automation for a gap spanning several missed fire times' (subsumed by 'property: at most one missed entry per automation per gap'), 'returns nothing for a fast-restart gap under the grace margin' (subsumed by 'property: sub-grace gaps never emit misses', whose generator was widened to seconds so the 2.5min fast restart is inside its range), and 'returns nothing for an ordinary tick-to-tick gap' + 'records nothing across ordinary consecutive ticks' (both subsumed by 'property: successive ordinary ticks accumulate zero misses'). The no-backfill contract did not shrink — only its redundant restatements did; the disabled-only-registry example was deliberately retained because its property twin never generates a zero-enabled registry.
